$comment: Cells adapter controlled configuration (file-storage/adapter/src/query-revision.mjs configuration()). Render with: adapter-delivery.py config --plan <bind plan> --template this --delivery-dir <CELLS_ADAPTER_DELIVERY_DIR> --out <CELLS_ADAPTER_CONFIG_FILE>. bindingId, tenantId, workspaceId and management.validation are filled from the plan. Replace every remaining {{...}} with the native facts. Core requires the adapter to map EVERY release action (list, read, list_revisions, export, write, delete, share), so readEdge, write, delete and share are mandatory; write/delete/share additionally require the native action delivery (CELLS_NATIVE_ACTION_CONFIG_FILE, file-storage/deploy/verify/deployment.md) whose nativeJobId values must match. actionTokenJwksFile must be inside the delivery directory (start.sh checks owner and 0400/0600): install the public-only ActionToken JWKS there.
nativeRootRef: {{Cells root node UUID of the bound workspace}}
oidcClientId: {{independent adapter client id, e.g. file-storage-adapter-<first 8 of bindingId>}}

write.nativeJobId: {{native write job id, equal to CELLS_NATIVE_ACTION_CONFIG_FILE write.nativeJobId}}

delete.nativeJobId: {{native delete job id, equal to CELLS_NATIVE_ACTION_CONFIG_FILE delete.nativeJobId}}
